title: Frozen contract: RenderDisplayList (v1)
description: Frozen at L0 per SPEC_RE_JOINTJS_PARITY.md §6 Lot 0. Source: spec/SPEC_RE_JOINTJS_PARITY.md §4.4 (lines 188-194): per occurrence, parts in markup order keyed by stable partId (selector replacement); each primitive is a positioned rect/ellipse, tessellated path, measured text run, marker instance, or overlay; paint order is occurrence z, then part order, then primitive order. Attribute resolution order: own box + calc(...) first, then ref rebasing with ref-x/ref-y/ref-dx/ref-dy/ref-width/ref-height/ref-d/ref-points and x-alignment/y-alignment; missing or cyclic ref is a degraded diagnostic, never a silent origin fallback (line 193). Port parts resolve after element parts; link label parts after connection geometry (§4.7). The list is handed to @sentropic/graph as typed buffers; text runs are measured once and drawn by the Canvas2D overlay, never via SVG getBBox (line 194).

partId.description: Stable selector name; 'root' is the occurrence itself (spec line 192).

ref.description: Optional sibling partId the reference box rebases to (spec line 193).

degraded.description: Named degradation when ref is missing/cyclic or a feature is outside the §4.8 policy; never a silent fallback.
